plugin.name: ida-chat
plugin.description: LLM Chat Client for IDA Pro - A dockable chat interface for AI-powered reverse engineering assistance using Claude Agent SDK.

settings.name: Show Setup Wizard
settings.documentation: Show the in-plugin setup wizard on launch to configure Claude authentication and test the connection.

settings.name: Authentication Type
settings.documentation: How to authenticate with Claude. 'system' reuses your existing Claude Code / keychain login; 'oauth' uses a Claude subscription (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise) token; 'api_key' uses an Anthropic Console API key.

settings.name: API Key or OAuth Token
settings.documentation: Anthropic Console API key or Claude OAuth token. Leave empty for 'system' authentication.
